in_hebrew.name: Nelle
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Graceful gift of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Nelle הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'nellos' which means 'graceful, gift, or offering'. In Christianity, Nelle represents the grace and blessing bestowed upon us by God.

in_latin.name: Nelle
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Graceful gift of God
